turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, and why was Owen's mark changed before anyone called me?
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.
Open mind? I'm here because of a zero. Who decided it, and was Owen asked anything first?
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.
I haven't ruled the principal out. You gave my son a zero, so what do you actually have?
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?
No. I don't agree to anything until I've seen what you have.
